  ],
  "analytical_usefulness": 0.83,
  "source_groundedness": 0.79,
  "rationale": "The added columns provide several genuinely useful new axes (acuity, reason category, organ system, intervention, workup intensity) that directly support relating reasons to urgency and duration across department/age. Values are mostly sound readings of the source text with sensible categorisation. Groundedness is slightly reduced by a few over-confident inferences: multi_system_involvement asserts True for a single-system cardiac case, and the 'endocrine' organ-system label for a general physical is thin. A couple of columns (chronic_disease_component, multi_system_involvement) offer weaker/partly redundant leverage. Overall a high-quality augmentation with minor grounding lapses."
}
